description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'AppHwConfigList' that displays a list of installed applications and allows users to navigate to preferences for specific applications. It includes an inner class 'AppListAdapter' which manages the display of app data, and the activity handles lifecycle methods for initialization and navigation upon list item clicks.

classes.name: AppHwConfigList
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays installed apps and allows navigation to application-specific settings.

classes.name: AppHwConfigList.AppListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter, managing the list of installed packages and handling view binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the package manager, adapter, and UI based on available apps.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle callback, currently only calls superclass.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle callback, currently only calls superclass.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items, starts an activity to display app preferences.

methods.name: appForPosition
methods.description: Returns the PackageInfo associated with the specified list position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of apps in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the list position (not the item itself).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a view for each list item and binds app data to it.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds application label to the list item view.
